items.source: The name of the single column to which the property is persisted.
items.translation: 属性持久化所对应的单列名称。

items.source: Determines whether this CassandraPersistentProperty is persisted (mapped) to an element ordinal when the owning type is a mapped tuple.
items.translation: 确定此CassandraPersistentProperty在拥有类型为映射元组时，是否被持久化（映射）到元素序数。

items.source: Returns whether the property is a Map.
items.translation: 返回该属性是否为Map。

items.source: The name of the element ordinal to which the property is persisted when the owning type is a mapped tuple.
items.translation: 当拥有者为映射元组时，该属性持久化到的元素序数的名称。

items.source: The required element ordinal to which the property is persisted when the owning type is a mapped tuple.
items.translation: 当拥有者为映射元组时，该属性被持久化到所需的元素序数。

items.source: Whether the property is a cluster key column.
items.translation: 该属性是否为聚簇索引列。

items.source: Whether the property is a composite primary key.
items.translation: 该属性是否为复合主键。

items.source: Whether the property is a partition key column.
items.translation: 该属性是否为分区键列。

items.source: Whether the property is a partition key column or a cluster key column
items.translation: 该属性是否为分区键列或聚类键列

items.source: Whether the property maps to a static column.
items.translation: 该属性是否映射到静态列。

items.source: Return whether the property has an explicitly configured column name. Eg. via Column.value(), PrimaryKey.value() or PrimaryKeyColumn.name()
items.translation: 返回该属性是否显式配置了列名。例如，通过 Column.value()、PrimaryKey.value() 或 PrimaryKeyColumn.name()。

items.source: If this property is mapped with a single column, set the column name to the given CqlIdentifier. If this property is not mapped by a single column, throws IllegalStateException. If the given column name is null, IllegalArgumentException is thrown.
items.translation: 如果该属性映射到单个列，请将列名设置为给定的 CqlIdentifier。如果该属性未映射到单个列，则抛出 IllegalStateException。如果给定的列名为 null，则抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

items.source: Find an AnnotatedType by annotationType derived from the property type.
items.translation: 通过从属性类型派生的annotationType查找一个AnnotatedType。

items.source: Find an AnnotatedType by annotationType derived from the property type. Annotated type is looked up by introspecting property field/accessors. Collection/Map-like types are introspected for type annotations within type arguments.
items.translation: 通过从属性类型派生的annotationType查找一个AnnotatedType。通过内省属性字段/访问器来查找注解类型。对于集合或 Map 类型的对象，会在类型参数中内省以查找类型注解。

items.source: Cassandra specific PersistentProperty extension.
items.translation: Cassandra 专用的 PersistentProperty 扩展。

items.source: If this property is mapped with a single column, set the column name to the given CqlIdentifier.
items.translation: 如果该属性映射到单个列，请将列名设置为给定的 CqlIdentifier。

items.source: The ordering (ascending or descending) for the column.
items.translation: 列的排序顺序（升序或降序）。

items.source: Return whether the property has an explicitly configured column name.
items.translation: 返回该属性是否显式配置了列名。

items.source:
The ordering (ascending or descending) for the column. Valid only for primary key columns; returns null for
non-primary key columns.
items.translation: 列的排序顺序（升序或降序）。仅适用于主键列；对于非主键列返回 null。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the required column name is not available.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果所需的列名不可用。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the required ordinal is not available.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果所需的序数不可用。

items.source: a boolean value indicating whether this CassandraPersistentProperty is persisted (mapped) to an element ordinal when the owning type is a mapped tuple.
items.translation: 一个布尔值，指示当拥有者类型为映射元组时，该 CassandraPersistentProperty 是否被持久化（映射）到元素序数。

items.source: a boolean indicating whether this property type is a Map.
items.translation: 一个布尔值，指示此属性类型是否为Map。

items.source: columnName - must not be null.
items.translation: columnName 不能为 null。

items.source: annotationType - must not be null.
items.translation: annotationType 不能为 null。

items.source: Alex Shvid, Matthew T. Adams, David T. Webb, Mark Paluch, John Blum, Christoph Strobl, Frank Spitulski, Aleksei Zotov
items.translation: Alex Shvid，Matthew T. Adams，David T. Webb，Mark Paluch，John Blum，Christoph Strobl，Frank Spitulski，Aleksei Zotov

items.source: true if a configured column name is present and non empty.
items.translation: 如果已配置的列名存在且非空，则返回 true。

items.source: true if the property should be embedded.
items.translation: 如果应嵌入该属性，则为 true。

items.source: the annotated type or null.
items.translation: 已注解的类型或 null。
